fields.description: Set when this run was executed by check_model_swap_safe() against a HYPOTHETICAL alternate/candidate model configuration rather than the platform's normal production routing.
fields.label: Is Model Swap Check

fields.description: Count of cases where the action predicted the secondary flag (e.g. is_safety_critical) TRUE but the labeled ground truth was FALSE.
fields.label: False Positive Count

fields.description: Count of cases where the action predicted the secondary flag FALSE but the labeled ground truth was TRUE.
fields.label: False Negative Count

fields.description: REAL, computed dimension: % of cases whose returned `sources` citation list correctly includes the case's own real input record.
fields.label: Source Support Score %

fields.description: A Data (text) field, deliberately NOT numeric — always literally 'N/A - mock adapter does not vary output' while ai_core._call_provider_adapter() stays mocked (see rubric_scoring_notes). A Float field cannot honestly represent 'not measurable' (Frappe reads an unset Float back as 0.0, which would misleadingly look like a real, bad, score of zero) — this platform's mock LLM adapter returns a fixed canned string regardless of input, so a generative groundedness score cannot be honestly measured at all, not even as a low one.
fields.label: Groundedness Score (N/A while mocked)

fields.description: A Data (text) field, deliberately NOT numeric — see groundedness_score's own description for why. The mock adapter never fabricates facts (it only echoes a template), so it cannot produce a hallucination for this metric to honestly detect.
fields.label: Hallucination Flag Rate (N/A while mocked)

fields.description: A Data (text) field, deliberately NOT numeric — see groundedness_score's own description for why. Actionability of freeform narrative text cannot be honestly scored against a fixed mock string.
fields.label: Actionability Score (N/A while mocked)

fields.description: JSON: real comparison against the immediately-prior AI Evaluation Run for this same action_code — {previous_run, previous_pass_rate, current_pass_rate, delta_percent, regressed}. The concrete basis for the 'never swap model without regression-testing against the internal eval set' governance principle.
fields.label: Regression vs Previous Run (JSON)

fields.description: JSON array: one entry per evaluated case (expected vs. actual category/severity/secondary flag, pass/fail, any pipeline error) — the human-reviewable detail behind the aggregate counts above.
fields.label: Per-Case Results (JSON)
